note: The digest runs in the CLOUD (GitHub Actions), not on this Mac. Schedule = three UTC crons in .github/workflows/pharma-digest.yml: Mon-Fri daily brief, Sat Week-in-Review, Sun Week-Ahead, all at 05:00 UTC = 07:00 Europe/Rome (summer/CEST). GitHub cron has no timezone, so re-run pharma-news/set_schedule.py (or the Command Centre's 'Set the daily send time') after a daylight-saving change to keep the local time exact.
